name: Setup Walkthrough
description: Agent-driven first-time setup playbook that walks new Ghola users through Obsidian, Atlassian credentials, and default module selection.

autoOfferOnFreshInstall.label: Auto-Offer On Fresh Install
autoOfferOnFreshInstall.description: When on (default), TPM offers the walkthrough proactively on a fresh install. Off requires the user to ask.

stages.label: Stages
stages.description: Walkthrough stages, each a name plus what TPM covers. Reorder, add, or disable stages without removing them.

obsidian.value: Confirm or set the Obsidian vault path — use the Detect Vault button in the Obsidian Notes panel to auto-fill it, or enter the Vault Path manually. Project notes live under Projects/.

atlassian.value: Walk through integration.atlassian-suite credential setup — Jira email, API token in SecretStorage, Jira base URL, Bitbucket workspace.

modules-default-set.value: Tour the Modules tab. Highlight which modules are default-enabled and which are opt-in. Suggest the typical-workflow toggles based on whether the user does ticket work, PR review, or both.

first-session.value: Suggest a low-stakes first session — open a small ticket in Ticket Work mode, watch the AC extract into todos, run the pre-PR trio on a real change. The user learns by doing, not by reading.

freshInstallSignal.label: Fresh Install Signal
freshInstallSignal.description: How TPM detects a fresh install. no-prior-handoff (default): checks for no Session Handoff blocks in the vault. empty-feedback-log: checks the feedback log. always-offer: offers every session. manual-only: never auto-offers.

paceMode.label: Pace Mode
paceMode.description: How TPM walks through stages. interactive (default): does one at a time. linear: covers all stages in one output. self-paced: lets the user pick order.

completionTracking.label: Completion Tracking
completionTracking.description: When on (default), TPM remembers completed/skipped stages so the walkthrough isn't re-offered. Off re-evaluates freshInstallSignal every session.
